corruption.def: A kinetic poison damage-over-time inflicted by Weapons of Sorrow and Necrotic Grip; potent corruption ramps up with each tick.
corruption.q: Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time.

blight.def: Witherhoard's Taken damage-over-time on a target or a pool on the ground; Malfeasance, Wish-Ender and One Thousand Voices deal extra damage to blighted targets.
blight.q: Projectiles fired by this weapon blight the target or nearby area on impact.

sivananite.def: Seeking SIVA nanites from Outbreak Perfected that attach to enemies; Outbreak and Wolfsbane deal more damage to nanite-covered targets.
sivananite.q: This weapon creates SIVA nanite swarms on rapid hits and precision kills.
